Register minimax_tts_api as a text_to_speech capability and map MiniMax-specific options through TextToSpeechProviderConfig.provider_options.
Map RuntimeTextToSpeechProviderConfig::minimax into the provider manager TTS bucket without changing chat pipeline wiring.

Run full workspace format, JSON, tests, clippy, and CLI smoke gates after Maestro records are updated.
